svg.title: Kogi State local government areas
svg.desc: Kogi East is highlighted, with labels for Ankpa, Bassa, Dekina, Ibaji, Idah, Igalamela-Odolu, Ofu, Olamaboro and Omala. Administrative boundaries are not language boundaries.
svg.metadata: GRID3 / geoBoundaries, 2022. CC BY 4.0. Adapted to rounded SVG coordinates; static companion to the About-page explorer.
